statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Delayed NQ has recovered to roughly flat versus Friday and is near its observed session high, while the overall path remains two-sided.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold; the European opening range, U.S. cash open and Dallas Fed survey are the next structure checkpoints.
headline: NQ recovery tempers Tail risk while Gulf escalation keeps Stress extreme
body: Delayed NQ is 29,509, up 0.06% from Friday's 29,491.75 close and near the observed 29,516.75 high after opening at 29,415.5. The rebound is material evidence of mean reversion, while renewed U.S.-Iran attacks, oil above $90 and elevated Treasury yields keep event/whipsaw Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Tail was 19% through 20:00 UTC, jumped on renewed U.S.-Iran escalation and peaked at 30% at 01:00 UTC, then eased through 28%, 24%, 23%, 22% and 21% as meaningful retracements persisted.
outlookSummary: Tail is 22% WATCH. The 07:00-09:00 UTC European opening range is the main near-term structure window; the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open and 14:30 UTC Dallas Fed survey are later conditional checkpoints.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ is 29,509, near the 29,516.75 observed high after opening at 29,415.5. The strong recovery raises near-high persistence risk, but the broader path remains two-sided, keeping Tail below the block threshold.
drivers: NQ recovery to near the delayed session high

forecast.analysis: After the initial European range forms, Tail stays at WATCH only if directional efficiency survives counter-moves. Rotation back through the opening range would favor a mixed rather than persistent path.

forecast.analysis: Mid-morning Europe is projected to carry lower Tail if the opening move becomes two-sided. A fresh session extreme followed by failed retracements would be the main condition for renewed escalation.
Tail eases toward the lower WATCH band if Europe continues rotating. The unresolved Gulf conflict keeps Stress high even without a persistent NQ direction.
Late Europe remains a transition hour. Tail stays near WATCH unless a clean range break is followed by repeated extension and weak counter-moves before U.S. participation increases.
U.S. premarket participation can re-amplify the overnight repricing. Tail rises conditionally if the gap or recovery becomes one-way and retracements remain shallow ahead of the cash open.

The 13:30 UTC cash open is a high-information checkpoint. Tail reaches 24% only if the opening auction holds near an extreme with shallow pullbacks or repeated extension; two-sided discovery would cap risk.

forecast.analysis: The first cash-hour and 14:30 UTC Dallas Fed release overlap. Tail remains at the top of WATCH only if post-open direction persists through retracements; the scheduled survey itself does not constitute observed Tail evidence.

After the Dallas Fed checkpoint, Tail falls if price discovery remains orderly and counter-moves are meaningful. A fresh catalyst plus repeated extension would be needed to sustain higher persistence risk.
Midday U.S. trading is expected to favor lower Tail absent fresh extremes. Cross-asset pressure matters mainly if NQ itself begins holding direction with failed pullbacks.
Tail stays near the lower WATCH band if midday rotation persists. A new one-way leg would require confirmation from NQ structure rather than headline importance alone.
Early afternoon remains conditional on whether the cash-session range is expanding or rotating. Meaningful retracements would keep Tail contained despite elevated Stress.

The U.S. late-session window can revive persistence risk if an established trend accelerates into the close. Tail rises only with observed-like conditions such as repeated extension and weak pullbacks.
Around the cash close, Tail stays at WATCH if directional pressure remains unresolved. A closing reversal or deeper counter-move would reduce the probability of a persistent path.
After the cash close, Tail eases if after-hours trading is orderly. Fresh military or shipping headlines remain a Stress amplifier but require price-path confirmation to lift Tail.
The next Globex session reopens a new price-discovery window. Tail stays in WATCH only if a gap develops and persists with shallow retracements; a balanced reopen would favor lower risk.
Early Globex Tail is projected lower if the reopen remains balanced. A sustained break from the new session range would be the principal conditional amplifier.
Asia's early handoff keeps Tail near WATCH while the geopolitical backdrop remains unresolved. The score rises only if NQ couples a fresh directional break with weak counter-moves.
Tail moves into LOW if Asian trading remains two-sided and no new discontinuity appears. Stress can remain extreme-to-high even while persistence risk declines.
The conditional path remains LOW if session extremes do not hold and retracements stay meaningful. A fresh one-way extension would invalidate that assumption.
Late Asia carries lower Tail under a stable-range assumption. Confidence is lower at this horizon, and any new verified catalyst would require reassessment rather than being presumed.
Ahead of Europe, Tail remains LOW if overnight structure is balanced. A new directional gap into the European handoff would be the main condition for a WATCH state.

The next European pre-open is a conditional WATCH checkpoint because unresolved Gulf risk can reprice across sessions. Tail reaches 20% only if the handoff shows renewed directional structure rather than rotation.

forecastDetail.comment: Delayed NQ has recovered to near its observed high; that raises near-high persistence risk, but the broader move is still two-sided, leaving Tail at WATCH.
Europe's first full hour is the top near-term WATCH point; only shallow pullbacks or repeated extension would justify persistence at 24%.
Once the European opening range is established, rotation through it would reduce Tail; sustained directional efficiency would keep WATCH elevated.
Mid-morning Tail falls if Europe becomes two-sided; fresh extremes plus failed retracements are the key invalidation.
Lower WATCH assumes continued European rotation while geopolitical conditions keep Stress extreme.
Late Europe remains transitional; repeated extension after a clean break is the main route to higher Tail.
